Title: AC01-002 Exclude File - File not found in shared drive

Action: Ensure no exclusion .xlsx file exists at <<PATH>>.
Expected Result: File is not present at path.
Job logs "file not found" and exits gracefully (failure or no-op) without crash.
No data inserted or modified.

Title: AC01-003 Exclude File - Access denied on shared drive

Action: Place an exclusion .xlsx file at <<PATH>> and remove read permission for the service account.
Expected Result: File exists but is not accessible by service account.
Job logs "access denied" or "permission denied" error and exits gracefully.
No data inserted or modified.

Title: AC01-004 Exclude File - Corrupt or unopenable file

Action: Place a corrupt/renamed .xlsx file at <<PATH>> (e.g. a .txt renamed to .xlsx).
Expected Result: File exists at path.
Job fails with actionable error indicating file is corrupt or unreadable.
No data inserted or modified.

Title: AC02-002 Exclude File - Empty required fields rejected

Action: Place a valid .xlsx file at <<PATH>> with one or more rows containing empty required fields.
Expected Result: File is visible and opens without error.
Job rejects rows with empty required fields; logs show row numbers and column names of failures.
Invalid rows not inserted. Valid rows processed normally.

Title: AC02-003 Exclude File - Invalid data types or malformed dates rejected

Action: Place a valid .xlsx file at <<PATH>> with rows containing invalid data types or malformed dates.
Expected Result: File is visible and opens without error.
Job rejects invalid rows; logs show row numbers and error detail.
Invalid rows not inserted. Valid rows processed normally.

Title: AC02-004 Exclude File - Duplicate exclusion keys rejected

Action: Place a valid .xlsx file at <<PATH>> with duplicate exclusion keys (e.g. same DRG code + effective date).
Expected Result: File is visible and opens without error.
Job rejects duplicate rows; logs identify which rows were duplicates.
Only one instance of each key inserted. Duplicates rejected.

Title: AC03-002 Exclude File - Update existing exclusion data

Action: Load an initial exclusion .xlsx file at <<PATH>> and trigger <<JOB_NAME>>.
Expected Result: Initial data loaded successfully.

Action: Place an updated exclusion .xlsx file at <<PATH>> with modified values for existing records.
Expected Result: File is visible and opens without error.
Existing records updated with new values; logs show update count.
Updated values reflected. No duplicate records created.

Title: AC03-003 Exclude File - Terminate/end-date existing exclusion records

Action: Load an initial exclusion .xlsx file at <<PATH>> and trigger <<JOB_NAME>>.
Expected Result: Initial data loaded successfully.

Action: Place an updated exclusion .xlsx file at <<PATH>> with termination/end dates for existing records.
Expected Result: File is visible and opens without error.
Records terminated/end-dated as expected; logs show termination count.
Terminated records reflect end date. Active records unchanged.

Title: AC03-004 Exclude File - Build number / commit artifact captured

Action: Trigger <<JOB_NAME>> with a valid exclusion .xlsx file at <<PATH>>.
Expected Result: Job completes successfully.

Action: Check audit/log table or job metadata.
Expected Result: Build number or commit artifact is captured and associated with this run.

Title: AC04-002 Exclude File - Machine-readable validation report

Action: Place an exclusion .xlsx file at <<PATH>> with a mix of valid and invalid rows.
Expected Result: File is visible and opens without error.
Job completes with partial success.
Report is machine-readable; shows pass/fail per row with reason codes.

Title: AC03-005 Mapping File - Partial failure with mixed valid and invalid rows

Action: Place a mapping .xlsx file at <<PATH>> with a mix of valid rows and invalid rows (e.g. bad data types or missing fields).
Expected Result: File is visible and opens without error.
Valid rows load successfully. Invalid rows rejected with row numbers and error detail.
Valid rows present. Invalid rows not inserted. Row counts match expected.
